parsed.post: Kept DEPTH=8 (val_bpb 0.998043). Increasing depth significantly improved performance. Next, I will try increasing the MATRIX_LR to 0.07 to see if the larger model can handle a slightly higher learning rate, as 0.05 might be too conservative for the increased capacity.
parsed.description: Increasing learning rate to 0.07 with DEPTH=8 to optimize convergence for the larger model capacity.
